content: firebase JS SDK is at 12.17.1 (Aug 2026); Expo officially requires firebase>=12.0.0 (ESM errors below). CRITICAL: Firestore durable offline persistence is IndexedDB-only and does NOT work in React Native/Expo Go — persistentLocalCache() throws 'unimplemented: This platform is either missing IndexedDB...' and silently falls back to memory cache (firebase-js-sdk issue #7947, open since Jan 2024; environments doc updated 2026-08-05 lists Firestore '(except persistence)' for React Native; source tree has no RN persistence impl). AsyncStorage is used only for AUTH persistence via initializeAuth(getReactNativePersistence(AsyncStorage)). Community shim expo-firestore-offline-persistence is unmaintained (author recommends RN Firebase). Offline in Expo Go = session-scoped memory cache only; queued offline writes are lost on app kill.
